comment: Known defects in released reboot wheels that lib/patch_reboot.py patches in a project's .venv after uv sync, add, remove and lock (bin/uv) and before rbt runs (bin/rbt). Each entry applies only to the reboot versions in `versions` (comma-separated ==, !=, <, <=, >, >= clauses) and, when `platforms` is set, only there. `find` must occur exactly once in `file` (relative to site-packages); it becomes `replace`. `marker` in the file means the fix is already there. Set `fixed_in` to the release that ships the fix and narrow `versions` to match. REBOOT_SKIP_PATCHES=1 turns the patcher off.

defects.description: protoc-gen-es output overflows execSync's default 1 MB buffer on a large API and `rbt generate` dies with ENOBUFS; maxBuffer raised to 256 MB.
LuaJIT in Envoy on macOS arm64 pins Envoy for about ten minutes after every restart and fan-outs die with `ping timeout`; the routing filters now turn the JIT off.
defects.replace:
def _lua_any(source_code: str) -> any_pb2.Any:
    source_code = "if jit then jit.off() end\n" + source_code
defects.after: stop rbt dev run and any orphaned envoy processes before starting it again
